name: portfolio
description: Personal portfolio of Glenn Wenand Arsemel Adorio — Computer Engineering Graduate & IT Professional

scripts.build: npm run sync-vendor && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); if(!html.includes('</html>')||!html.includes('</body>')) throw new Error('Missing closing HTML/BODY tags'); if(/toggleGameMode|Game Mode|car\.png|joystick/i.test(html)) throw new Error('Game Mode reference found'); console.log('Build verification passed.');"

author: Glenn Wenand Arsemel Adorio
